label: Heartbeat Line
author: Conky-Studio
description: ECG-style heartbeat polyline that scrolls. Spike rate / height can follow Trigger.
lua_draw_body:
local x0, y0, W, H = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local trig = math.min(tonumber({trigger}) or 50, 100) / 100
 local bpm = {bpm} * (0.6 + 0.8 * trig)
 local period = 60 / math.max(bpm, 1)
 local t = wall_clock()
 local r, g, b = {color}
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity})
 cairo_set_line_width(cr, {line_width})
 cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
 local steps = math.max(40, math.floor(W / 2))
 cairo_new_path(cr)
 for i = 0, steps do
  local u = i / steps
  local px = x0 + u * W
  -- phase within beat, scrolled
  local phase = ((u * 1.6) + t / period) % 1
  local y = y0
  if phase < 0.08 then
   y = y0
  elseif phase < 0.12 then
   y = y0 - H * ((phase - 0.08) / 0.04)
  elseif phase < 0.16 then
   y = y0 - H + H * 1.6 * ((phase - 0.12) / 0.04)
  elseif phase < 0.20 then
   y = y0 + H * 0.6 - H * 0.6 * ((phase - 0.16) / 0.04)
  elseif phase < 0.28 then
   y = y0 - H * 0.25 * math.sin((phase - 0.20) / 0.08 * math.pi)
  else
   y = y0
  end
  if i == 0 then cairo_move_to(cr, px, y) else cairo_line_to(cr, px, y) end
 end
 cairo_stroke(cr)
